sources: https://secure.rec1.com/GA/dawson-county-recreation/catalog (Reservations / Rentals > War Hill Park, Campsites 1-14 and the War Hill Park Rules)

fees.source: https://www.dawsoncountyga.gov/353/Lake-Parks ('The nightly rate for camping is $25') + War Hill Park Information PDF revised 6/23/25 ('$25 per campsite per day') + secure.rec1.com catalog (every War Hill campsite '$25/Multi-Day ($350 Max)'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.dawsoncountyga.gov/353/Lake-Parks ('All campsites are primitive and do not have power, water, or dump stations') + rec1 site pages ('All campsites at War Hill Park are primitive and do not have hook-ups'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 14 sites, each with its own posted camper length: 30 ft (sites 1 and 10), 40 ft (2, 3, 4, 9, 11, 13), 45 ft (5, 7, 8), 50 ft (12, 14); site 6's back-in driveway runs up to 80 ft but is slightly elevated. Pull-throughs on curved driveways: 1, 2, 9, 12, 13, 14. Several driveways are on an incline, and sites 1, 2 and 14 have a stairway from the driveway down to the pad. One camper trailer or motorhome per site.

sites.source: War Hill Park Information PDF, campsite pages ('Space for 30'/40'/45'/50' maximum camper', 'Pull-through, curved driveway', 'Long (up to 80') but slightly elevated') + rec1 War Hill Park Rules ('only one camper trailer or motor home is allowed per site'), read 2026-10-30. The stored 30-ft max came from Campendium; the county's per-site specs replace it.

values.note: Bathhouse with restrooms and showers; camp host on site; swimming beach and pier.

facilities.source: https://www.dawsoncountyga.gov/353/Lake-Parks ('14 primitive campsites (no hook-ups or dump station), day-use areas, a bathhouse (restrooms and showers)') + Information PDF ('Host Camper onsite', 'Beach onsite'), read 2026-10-30

season.source: https://www.dawsoncountyga.gov/353/Lake-Parks ('the campsites close in the winter each year (open March 1 to October 31)') + Information PDF ('Open March 1-October 31'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Online only, through Dawson County Parks & Recreation's Rec1 catalog (Reservations / Rentals > War Hill Park); an account is needed to add a site to the cart. Changes and cancellations by phone, with a $10 service fee. Check-in 4 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.dawsoncountyga.gov/353/Lake-Parks ('Campsite reservations for Toto Creek Park and War Hill Park are online only'; 'RESERVE A CAMPSITE ONLINE' -> secure.rec1.com) + rec1 War Hill Park Rules ('CHECK-OUT TIME is 11:00 AM', 'CHECK-IN TIME is 4:00 PM', 'LENGTH OF STAY is no longer than 14 days') + Information PDF cancellation policy updated 2/2/24, read 2026-10-30

note: Dawson County park on a Lake Lanier peninsula off GA-53 east of Dawsonville, with a swimming beach, pier and four boat ramps; fishing tournaments launch from the ramps early in the morning. Alcohol prohibited. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (county page, 2025 PDF, Rec1 catalog), no hookups, no dump, showers, Mar 1 - Oct 31 (now manual from the county's own pages), online-only reservations. Added the Rec1 booking link, 14-night max, fcfs never, check-in 4 pm / out 11 am. max_rig_ft 30 -> 50 from the county's per-site specs (30-50 ft, site 6 up to 80 ft), pull-through true. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upward): stored 'not waterfront', but the county's own War Hill Park Information PDF (revised 6/23/25) marks 12 of the 14 campsites 'On the water' (all but 3 and 10), with per-site water entry ratings ('Easy water entry with private beach-like area' on 9, 'Excellent water entry' on 13). Satellite at the pin shows the campsite loop circling a small Lake Lanier peninsula. Needs a waterfront re-audit under the gate.
Phone 706-344-3646 confirmed (county page, PDF, Rec1 facility pages).
Pin 34.33118,-83.96351 sits on the park road at the base of the campsite peninsula, between the day-use area and the loop: fine.
Rec1 needs an account to add a site to the cart, but every site's price is visible without one (checkout-only login).

Boat ramp $6/day applies to launching, not to campers; not stored as an entrance fee. The county's annual boat-ramp pass gives no camping discount, and the page lists the Access and Senior passes as giving 'camping discounts' under the USACE agreement without saying the county honors them on campsite fees, so discounts are not set.
